crossRefs.note: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment…
But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem, and…
